Test helpers for txn and rec management in funk, including insert, publish, cancel, and delete.

# Purpose
This file implements a small in-memory test version of the `funk` transaction and record system. It defines helper functions to add and remove `txn_t` and `rec_t` objects from linked lists, manage parent and child transaction links, and maintain global maps of all transactions and records in a `funk_t` instance. The code supports transaction creation with [`txn_prepare`](<#txn_prepare>), transaction cancel with [`txn_cancel`](<#txn_cancel>), and transaction publish with [`txn_publish`](<#txn_publish>), where record changes from a transaction are moved into the root record list and older root records with the same key are removed.

The file also provides record lookup and insert functions, plus allocation and cleanup for the top-level `funk_t` object with [`funk_new`](<#funk_new>) and [`funk_delete`](<#funk_delete>). At the end, it defines small test utilities such as [`xid_unique`](<#xid_unique>) and [`key_eq`](<#key_eq>). This code is intended for unit tests or local test support, not as a public library interface, and it depends on the transaction and record types declared in `test_funk_common.h`.
